provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Arkham Horror rulebook, 2005 edition (Fantasy Flight Games)

steps.text: Board in the center; tokens and dice around it; terror track marker on 0
1 Clue token on each location with a red diamond (the 11 unstable locations)
Mythos side of the board: 9 Location decks, Gate deck, Mythos deck, Gate markers, Clue tokens, Activity, Closed and Explored markers
Investigator side: Ally, Common Item, Unique Item, Spell and Skill decks, Special card decks, Sanity, Stamina and money banks
Pick a first player at random: they take the first player marker
First player shuffles the 16 investigator sheets and deals 1 to each player (or choose, clockwise)
Reveal 1 random Ancient One sheet and resolve any start-of-game ability
steps.note: You may choose instead: Yig is shorter, Cthulhu is harder

steps.text: Starting from the first player, hand out each investigator's Fixed Possessions
Shuffle the Common Item, Unique Item, Spell and Skill decks
Each player draws their Random Possessions
Sanity and Stamina tokens equal to your investigator's values; 3 skill sliders, one on any stop of each skill track
All monster markers into an opaque monster cup
Shuffle the Gate and Mythos decks; shuffle the 16 Gate markers facedown
Investigator markers on their Home locations; box the unused sheets
First player draws and resolves a Mythos card; redraw if it is a Rumor
Put a doom token on the Ancient One's doom track after the first gate opens
The first player marker passes left at the end of every turn
After the Mythos card is resolved, the first turn begins with the Upkeep phase
